subject: Post-call recap & brief walkthrough — two time options for Tech + Procurement

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + propose two windows for a 30-min walkthrough

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: HealthGrid is focused on lowering inference cost for batch-reporting pipelines and tightening latency for clinician-facing searches; security/compliance scope will be SOC2 + regionally isolated logs. We covered platform fit, two initial pilot success metrics (95th-p50 tail latency under target, and 30% token-cost reduction vs current infra).

Next step I recommend: a 30-minute product walkthrough (brief demo + Q&A) where we bring an engineer (ops/infra) and a solutions engineer to validate integration surface. Can you confirm who from your side should join (tech lead + procurement is typical)?

Two narrow windows that work for our team next week (PT):
- Tue Mar 2, 9:00–9:30am PT
- Wed Mar 3, 11:00–11:30am PT

If neither works, tell me two 30-min bands that do and we’ll align. I attached a one-pager agenda and the raw notes from today.

Prep asks (just so we’re efficient):
- Can the tech attendee have access to a sample prompt or perf target (latency P95 goal)?
- Any procurement timing constraints or legal POC needs we should be aware of?

I’ll loop in Aditya (sales manager) and Monica (customer success) once we lock a time.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
